name: orthomcl-one-protein-in-every-apicomplexan-genome
turns: List the ortholog groups that have exactly one protein in every apicomplexan genome.
rationale: The reworded suggestion has one reading: the apicomplexan clade code with a taxon count equal to its genome count and a protein count equal to the same number. The clade's genome count comes from the taxonomy, never from the model's memory.

provenance.curatorNote: The single-reading form of the suggested prompt; no question is needed.
